title: Uniform probability of a binary subspace
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $A$ be a subspace of $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$. Its uniform probability is the probability that a uniformly chosen vector in $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$ belongs to $A$.
